name: Shuujin to Issho!
source:
The Innate Goodness Theory. The belief that the human soul is inherently virtuous.
...Basically, it's the notion that every human starts out pure at birth.

So then, wouldn't making prisoners revert to infancy lead to rehabilitation?
It was through this sort of national experiment that I became a mother.

I clench the pacifier. If I'm gonna do this, I'm going all in.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10127]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
与生俱来的善良理论。相信人类灵魂本质上是善良的。
…基本上，这是每个人出生时都是纯洁的观念。

那么，让囚犯回到婴儿期不就可以改过自新了吗？
正是通过这种全国性的实验，我成为了一名母亲。

我握紧了奶嘴。如果我要这么做，我会全力以赴。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10127]Novelgame[/url]]
